title: A nonzero finite reduced algebra without nontrivial idempotents over an algebraically closed field has dimension 1
statement: Let $K$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure] and let $B$ be a commutative $K$-algebra which is finite-dimensional as a $K$-vector space, is reduced (has no nonzero nilpotent element), is not the zero ring ($1\neq0$ in $B$), and whose only idempotents $e=e^2$ are $0$ and $1$. Then $\dim_KB=1$, i.e. the structure map $K\to B$ is bijective.
